title: TLS verification disabled (verify=False) — review required
description: Certificate verification is explicitly disabled for an HTTPS client call, so the connection accepts any certificate, including an attacker's. Credentials, tokens, and response data crossing that connection can be intercepted. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it never ships.
remediation: Delete verify=False and let the client verify against the system trust store. For private CAs, pass the CA bundle path explicitly instead of disabling verification.
limitation: Lexical: matches verify=False exactly, so verify_signature and other similarly named flags never match. Call-site dataflow (which host is contacted) is out of scope.
